scope: structural-model-only; game consumer and colors unverified

commands.1: literal count low nibble then one big-endian extension byte
commands.8: repeat low-nibble count, next byte value
commands.9: repeat next byte value, then count extension1
commands.a: repeat next byte value, then count extension2

unsupported: 0x2 literal extension2 was not observed in retained corpus model; all other opcodes reject
count_policy: strictly positive, no output overrun or underrun, all encoded bytes consumed
output: owned index bytes plus independent known masks for pixel and opaque palette positions; unknown byte storage zero must not be interpreted as known color/index

api.record: optional own data UInt32 byteLength/width/height; supplied values must match
api.ownership: attached nonshared Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer copied after input budget check; independent mutable output arrays; temporary copy wiped
api.known_masks: 1 literal or explicit repeat; 0 C/D/E position. Not an alpha mask.

verified_local_corpus.raw_v0_v2: existing decoder unchanged; 69 raw records outside new API
